title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover ordering
description: Urgent hotfix to address SLO enforcer ordering bug that caused regional failover thrashing under partially degraded capacity. Root cause: race between backoff timer refresh and region-choice decision path that could clear circuit-breaker state out of order when a cached health update arrived concurrently. Impact: during a recent canary scale-down we observed repeated cross-region failovers and aggressive load-shedding that violated our 99th percentile latency SLO for hosted API customers. This PR adds deterministic ordering to SLO enforcer state transitions, adds an extra safety window before clearing backoff for a region, hardens concurrent updates with compare-and-set semantics, and tightens metrics/alerts for the enforcer to detect oscillation. Includes small performance guard to avoid additional contention in the fast path. Changes were validated in a canary region and replayed the synthetic load that reproduced the incident. Patch is scoped as a hotfix and should be cherry-picked to release/2024-11 for customer-facing fixes.
